description.narrative: This project will carry out multiple activities in the Natural Protected Area Area de Proteccion de..Flora y Fauna Laguna Madre y Delta del Rio Bravo (APFFLMDRB), which is also a RAMSAR site...(1.a.) Develop 10-year federal work program agreements (programas de trabajo) with the..APFFLMDRB for 9,680 hectares/ 23909.6 acres: the locations include 7,000 hectares/17,290 acres of..islands and seagrasses in La Capilla, 2,000 hectares/4,940 acres of seagrass in Laguna Morales, and..680 hectares/1,680 acres in Laguna Balsora. (1.b.) Protect 248 hectares/612.56 acres on Laguna La..Palangana through a 10-year conservation agreement. (2.a.) Restore (300 hectares/741 acres) of..mangroves in Laguna Morales and La Capilla. (2.b.) Enhance (750 hectares/1,853 acres) of wetlands..in Laguna Balsora by rebuilding a levee (225 meters/738 ft). (2.c.) In Laguna La Palangana, restore..(100 hectares/247 acres) of freshwater wetland trough dredging (15 hectares/37 acres), enhance (100..hectares/247 acres) by clearing vegetation, stabilizing soil and creating a windbreak barrier by..seeding native plants (20 hectares/49 acres). (2.d.) Complete two Environmental Impact Manifest..exemptions to authorize restoration activities. (3.a.) Complete a hydrological characterization study of..Laguna Balsora and Laguna Honda. (3.b.) Complete a topography study in Laguna La Palangana to..support restoration activities. (3.c.) Monitor biological characteristics in Laguna Morales, Laguna..Balsora and Laguna La Palangana and La Capilla. (4.a.) Develop an education strategy aimed at 200..children and 15 teachers in three communities. (4.b.) Conduct community-based surveillance in..Laguna Madre. (4.c.) Supervise environmental programs and detect and report environmental crimes..in northern Laguna Madre. (5) Develop a management plan for the sustainable use of natural..resources with an emphasis on ecotourism and birdwatching..
